profile.headline: MS in Computer Science Student @ Northeastern University
profile.summary: I graduated from Northeastern University with a Master's degree in Computer Science. I have experience in working with web-based and mobile applications and the opportunity to hone my skills with Java, Kotlin, Python, PHP, AngularJs, jQuery, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Android Studio, Firebase, and Google API. My main responsibilities over these experiences have been to design databases, maintain the web server, update system requirements, and optimize web and mobile applications development projects. I have excellent organizational skills with the ability to work on multiple projects at once and still maintain efficiency and meet deadlines. I have lots of patience and excellent math skills with the ability to solve complex problems.

positions.title: Android Software Engineer Co-Op
positions.description:
· Participate in the full development lifecycle, including design, coding, automated testing, and production releases
· Collaborate closely with product owners, management, cross-functional teams and deliver compelling solutions
· Write unit and UI tests to identify malfunctions
· Troubleshoot and debug to optimize performance
· Design interfaces to improve user experience
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Android Development · Databases · GitHub · Kotlin

positions.title: Graduated Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Courses: CS5001 Intro to Programming, CS 5200 Database Management
• Held weekly office hours to help students with homework and other course material questions
• Created rubrics and graded all homework assignments and exams
• Provided feedback and guidance to 300+ students

positions.title: Web Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
Work with GRC Team to develop database applications to automate GRC Inventory management process 
Organized project plans and adhere to benchmarks and established project timelines
Developed and tested two mobile-friendly  web applications using PHP, MySQL, jQuery, and Wordpress
Generated automated productivity reports to trend and calculate the daily performance of the inventory process
Maintained and updated applications by running backups and tuning queries

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

projects.title: Brain-Computer Interface
projects.description:
•	Created a BCI application that uses EEG signals to control drones.
•	Collected, and labeled EEG signals using unsupervised machine learning.
•	Built a deep learning model using Tensorflow with an accuracy of 93% to classify EEG signals, and deployed the model in the AirSim simulator and on the Android platform.
•	Won 1st place in the 3-minute Pitch-A-Thon, a university technology competition.
